findings.detail: AC1 requires each row to carry 'that location and its quantity', but no test in the revised list asserts the rendered row content includes the location name or the quantity value. T25 asserts only row count ('one row per location is visible') and T26 asserts only the data-testid seam; a Driver can render rows with data-testid='location-row' containing no text and satisfy both tests while failing AC1's 'then' clause. A client test asserting that each row contains the location name text and the quantity number is missing.
